messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222.
Too much metoprolol can cause a dangerously slow heartbeat, very low blood pressure, and cardiogenic shock. It can also cause heart block, heart failure, wheezing, low oxygen levels, drowsiness or loss of consciousness, nausea, and vomiting. Overdose is treated in an intensive care setting. Dialysis does not remove metoprolol effectively.
Triplet: ["metoprolol", "treated in", "intensive care setting"]

The relation 'treated in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug overdose is managed or treated in the medical setting or environment specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
